label: lora_plus_ssm
description: Hybrid-aware LoRA targeting Mamba projections + attention, with SSM core parameters (A_log, D, dt_bias) unfrozen during training. SSM monkey-patch enables proper gradient flow through Mamba-2 SSD layers. Major breakthrough in all tasks. However, PEFT's save_model() triggers inference_mode which discards SSM gradients — trained SSM values NOT persisted in saved checkpoint.

lora_config.note: Hybrid-aware targets covering both attention (4 layers) and Mamba-2 (36 layers) projections. Requires SSM monkey-patch for gradient flow.

ssm_config.ssm_persistence_note: PEFT bug: trainer.save_model() calls inference_mode on LoRA layers, which freezes all parameters. SSM core params saved via ssm_core_params.pt contain base model values, not trained values.

key_finding: Despite SSM values not persisting to checkpoint, V3 gains +11.4 points classification over V2 (52.2 vs 40.8). This reveals a co-training effect: unfreezing SSM params during training improves LoRA weight optimization even when SSM values revert to base at inference.
